facts.value: The Joint Services Transcript has replaced the Coast Guard Institute Transcript, the Army/American Council on Education Registry Transcript System, and the Sailor/Marine American Council on Education Registry Transcript.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: All enlisted members, officers and warrant officers, both active and veterans from all Army components, Coast Guard, Marine Corps and Navy, are eligible for a JST.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: You do not have to be on active duty to access the JST website and your transcript. Active duty, reserve, veterans or National Guard personnel can use JSTs.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Some students may have concerns about a security warning when accessing the website. This happens when a user logs in to a Department of Defense network from a non-networked computer without a CAC.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: You can confirm the security exception to proceed to the JST request site. If you do not confirm this exception, you will be unable to place your order.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Register for a JST account, and direct the DoD to send your transcript to ASU.
